summary: Learn to map, deploy, and govern frontline AI with practical controls, dashboards, and integration plans. Enrol with TrainingCred.
lede: Operational AI training shows you how to turn promising AI pilots into practical frontline workflows with clear ownership, escalation paths, service measures, and human review. You will assess process suitability and data readiness, map current-state processes with BPMN 2.0, define automation boundaries, and select use cases using value-versus-feasibility scoring. Using the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and ISO/IEC 42001:2023 and ISO/IEC 23894:2023 concepts, you will create use-case scorecards, control registers, deployment decisions, test sets, and monitoring views. Hands-on activities include designing a human review queue, shaping a low-code Microsoft Power Automate workflow, and using sample data in Power BI while addressing exceptions, fallback procedures, access controls, data minimisation, and controlled releases.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals responsible for turning AI ideas into controlled, measurable frontline workflows. It is especially relevant when you need to connect operational targets with responsible AI decisions, existing platforms, and workforce realities.
audience: MEAL Managers using AI for data quality
Responsible AI and Data Governance Specialists
prerequisites: You should have working experience in at least one operational function such as customer service, field operations, MEAL, programme delivery, finance operations, product ownership, or digital transformation. No coding or model-building experience is required. You should bring one real or representative workflow, its current performance measures if available, and a basic understanding of the systems used by your team. Advanced AI engineering, custom model training, and production deployment are outside the practical scope of this course and receive conceptual coverage only.
